title: The minimum number of distinct abelian squares in a binary circular word
description:
Sharp lower bound and complete extremal classification for distinct abelian-square factors of binary circular words, for every positive length. This proves the odd case and corrects the even extremal list in Simpson's Conjecture 0.6.

Version 2.2.0 adds the amsart Hexagon replacement and journal preparation package under [PAPER] package/. The mathematical proof body and Lean/checking sources are preserved from commit a08e1ce81c2f8c863844473f5ad56e02ac9cc212. Verification scope and existing successful CI evidence are recorded. The separate linear-word conjecture is not claimed. The human-understanding declaration remains the existing Hexagon declaration.
